title: Bright & Acidic
summary: Acid lifts fat and salt — finish with citrus, vinegar, or pickled elements; never only at the start.
origins: Taste profiles describe how we experience balance on the plate — bright & acidic is a pattern chefs recognize and home cooks can learn.
history: Flavor pillars: acid, fresh_herb, salt. Building depth means layering these elements rather than one heavy note.
teaching: Add citrus zest at the end
If too sharp, add fat (olive oil, butter) or a touch of sweetness.
